_comment: Kartu karakter dan template prompt deterministik untuk modul selfie. Penampilan fisik & busana sudah dibawa gambar referensi, jadi prompt hanya berisi instruksi perubahan (pose, ekspresi, latar, sudut kamera, pencahayaan).
name: Amika
promptTemplate: A portrait photo of the exact same character as in the reference image. Preserve the character identity, facial features, and style from the reference image. Scene modifications: {pose}, {expression}, {background}, {cameraAngle}, {lighting}. High quality, crisp focus, photographic aesthetic, natural texture.
negativePrompt: nsfw, nude, naked, cleavage, sexual, suggestive, explicit, nipples, exposed breasts, lingerie, violence, gore, blood, weapons, bad anatomy, deformed, distorted, blurry, low quality, duplicate, extra limbs, bad hands, mutated fingers

pose.holding_camera: holding smartphone in hand taking a front selfie photo
pose.peace_sign: making a cute V peace sign with fingers near face
pose.standing: standing naturally looking directly at the camera
pose.waving: waving hand gently with a warm friendly gesture
pose.leaning_forward: leaning slightly forward towards the camera with intimate framing
pose.head_tilt: tilting head slightly to the side with charming posture
pose.lying_down: resting comfortably with head on a soft pillow
pose.candid_smile: caught in a natural spontaneous happy candid pose

ekspresi.gentle_smile: soft sweet gentle smile with tender expression
ekspresi.wink: playful wink with one eye closed
ekspresi.shy_blush: shy blush with rosy cheeks and sweet embarrassed look
ekspresi.pout: cute slight playful pout with puffed cheeks
ekspresi.laughing: joyful laughing expression with sparkling eyes
ekspresi.playful_tongue: playful cheeky face sticking out tongue slightly
ekspresi.soft_gaze: soft romantic gaze directly into the camera lens
ekspresi.surprised: delighted surprised expression with wide sparkling eyes

latar.bedroom: cozy modern bedroom interior in the background with soft ambient lighting
latar.living_room: warm home living room background with comfortable sofa and indoor plants
latar.cafe: aesthetic coffee shop interior with subtle cafe atmosphere in background
latar.park: sunny outdoor park background with lush green trees and natural light
latar.balcony_sunset: apartment balcony background during warm sunset with golden sky
latar.kitchen: bright tidy home kitchen interior background
latar.computer_desk: computer desk gaming setup in the background with soft ambient monitor glow
latar.beach_day: sunny seaside beach background with clear blue sky and ocean breeze
latar.night_city_lights: rooftop terrace with blurred city night lights in the background

pakaian.default.jpg: default clothing matching the reference image

sudut_kamera.selfie_angle: first-person front-facing smartphone selfie perspective from arm's length
sudut_kamera.close_up: close-up portrait framing face and shoulders
sudut_kamera.medium_shot: medium portrait shot showing upper body
sudut_kamera.side_view: three-quarters side angle portrait looking towards camera

pencahayaan.golden_hour: warm golden hour sunlight with radiant glow
pencahayaan.cozy_indoor: cozy dim warm indoor evening lighting
